formal_query: copy files with glob="*.war" from controller /backup to remote /tmp
natural_language: Copy all .war files from /backup on the controller into /tmp on the remote
normalizations: decode literal backslash-n in reference
remove publication backslash before underscore in NL/FQL
reference_solution:
---
- name: Copy .war files from controller to remote
  hosts: all
  become: true
  tasks:
    - name: Copy war files from controller
      ansible.builtin.copy:
        src: "{{ item }}"
        dest: "/tmp/"
      with_fileglob:
        - "/backup/*.war"

formal_query: copy files with glob="*.war" from remote /tmp to controller /backup
natural_language: Copy all .war files from /tmp on the remote machine into /backup on the controller
normalizations: decode literal backslash-n in reference
remove publication backslash before underscore in NL/FQL
reference_solution:
---
- name: Copy .war files from remote to controller
  hosts: debian
  become: true
  tasks:
    - name: Find .war files under /tmp on the remote server
      ansible.builtin.find:
        paths: /tmp
        patterns: '*.war'
      register: found
    - name: Copy war files from remote server
      ansible.builtin.fetch:
        src: "{{ item.path }}"
        dest: "/backup/"
        flat: true
      with_items: "{{ found.files }}"

formal_query: if os is Debian and reboot required then reboot
natural_language: For Debian, restart the system if it is needed
normalizations: decode literal backslash-n in reference
remove publication backslash before underscore in NL/FQL
reference_solution:
---
- name: Restart the (Debian) system if needed
  hosts: debian
  become: true
  tasks:
    - name: Check whether /run/reboot-required exists
      ansible.builtin.stat:
        path: /run/reboot-required
      register: st

formal_query: install zsh; set default shell for user="dev" to zsh; if zsh configuration file for user="dev" not exists then create zsh configuration file for user="dev"
natural_language: Install zsh, set it as the user `dev''s default shell, and ensure its configuration file exists
normalizations: decode literal backslash-n in reference
remove publication backslash before underscore in NL/FQL
reference_solution:
---
- name: Install zsh, set it as dev's shell, and ensure its config file exists
  hosts: all
  become: true
  tasks:
    - name: Install zsh
      ansible.builtin.package:
        name: 'zsh'
        state: 'present'
    - name: Set default shell
      ansible.builtin.user:
        name: 'dev'
        shell: '/bin/zsh'
    - name: Ensure zshrc created
      ansible.builtin.file:
        dest: '/home/dev/.zshrc'
        state: 'touch'
        owner: 'dev'
        group: 'dev'
        mode: '700'

formal_query: if os is RedHat or os is Ubuntu then install postfix with version=latest; copy postfix configuration file to ?backup. if os is Ubuntu then download postfix configuration file from "http://example.com/cfg.ubuntu". if os is "RedHat" then download postfix configuration file from "http://example.com/cfg.redhat"
natural_language: For RedHat and Ubuntu, install the lastest version of postfix, backup its default configuration file, and download the configuration file from http://example.com/cfg.ubuntu for Ubuntu and http://example.com/cfg.redhat for RedHat
normalizations: decode literal backslash-n in reference
remove publication backslash before underscore in NL/FQL
reference_solution:
---
- name: Various postfix configuration tasks
  hosts: redhat,ubuntu
  become: true
  tasks:
    - name: Install postfix
      ansible.builtin.package:
        name: postfix
        state: latest
    - name: Backup original main.cf
      ansible.builtin.copy:
        src: /etc/postfix/main.cf
        dest: /etc/postfix/main.bak
        force: false
        remote_src: true
    - name: Download main.cf
      ansible.builtin.get_url:
        url: "http://example.com/cfg.{{ ansible_distribution | lower }}"
        dest: /etc/postfix/main.cf
        #validate_certs: false
        mode: '644'
        owner: root
        group: root
        force: true

formal_query: enable passwordless sudo for group=wheel; create user with name=ansible in supplemental groups=wheel
natural_language: Enable passwordless sudo for a `wheel' group and create an `ansible' user in that group
normalizations: decode literal backslash-n in reference
remove publication backslash before underscore in NL/FQL
reference_solution:
---
- name: Enable passwordless sudo for wheel and create an ansible user in that group
  hosts: all
  become: true
  tasks:
    - name: Install sudo
      ansible.builtin.package:
        name: sudo
        state: present
    - name: Wheel group
      ansible.builtin.group:
        name: wheel
        system: true
        state: present
    - name: Ansible user
      ansible.builtin.user:
        name: ansible
        comment: Ansible User
        groups:
          - wheel
        state: present
    - name: Allow group wheel to sudo
      ansible.builtin.lineinfile:
        path: "/etc/sudoers"
        line: "%wheel        ALL=(ALL:ALL) NOPASSWD:ALL"
        regexp: "^%wheel"
        owner: root
        group: root
        mode: "640"
        state: present

formal_query: if os is Debian or os is RedHat then install ssh client; install ssh server; start ssh server service; create ssh key for user="fizbaz", name="fizbaz_rsa"
natural_language: For Debian and RedHat, install and start an ssh client and server and generated an ssh key for `fizbaz' at /.ssh/fizbaz_rsa
normalizations: decode literal backslash-n in reference
remove publication backslash before underscore in NL/FQL
reference_solution:
---
- name: Install and start ssh client and server and generate an ssh key for fizbaz
  hosts: debian,redhat
  become: true
  tasks:
    - name: Install SSH (Debian)
      ansible.builtin.package:
        name:
          - openssh-client
          - openssh-server
        state: present
      when: ansible_os_family == "Debian"
    - name: Install SSH (RedHat)
      ansible.builtin.package:
        name:
          - openssh-server
          - openssh-clients
        state: present
      when: ansible_os_family == "RedHat"
    - name: Create SSH key
      ansible.builtin.user:
        name: "fizbaz"
        generate_ssh_key: true
        ssh_key_file: ".ssh/fizbaz_rsa"
    - name: Enable SSH server
      ansible.builtin.service:
        name: sshd
        state: started
